Changelog

formex 0.0.0.9000

  • Tag sets. New is_tags() detector + as_tags verb wire the categorical/multiselect/tags leaf, so a flat delimited set ("a|b|c", "Volunteer;Donor;Board" — a list column collapsed to a string) is recognized and normalized to a ;-joined form, instead of going unrecognized.

  • Fixes from datagoodr’s dplyr::starwars detection-quality report:

    • Named colors. New is_color_name() detector + a curated color-word lexicon (CSS/X11 + descriptive and hair/eye terms) and a text/color/color_name leaf, so hair_color / eye_color columns resolve to a color type instead of leaking to geographic (the color words “brown”, “auburn”, “orange” are also US place names). The leaf joins the verifier’s always-on set. is_color_name() also accepts all-color compounds ("brown, grey", "blue-gray", "dark brown") and rejects fillers ("none", "unknown"), so real hair_color / eye_color columns (which mix single and compound values) resolve to the color type instead of staying on geographic.
    • Stabilizing to the default format is reachable. The canonical value a recipe produces already is the type’s default written form, so a write edge to each row’s desired_default_format is generated by identity — a date renders to yyyymmdd, a measurement/number to numeric, a year to yyyy, instead of “no path”. (Generalizes the earlier write_numeric; fixes the baseball birthDate / debut dates reported by datagoodr.) Unit menus (e.g. unit-specific (kg;;m;;C;;L)) collapse to no unit for planning.

  • v7 ontology + transform API. The leaf gains two orthogonal axes — format_style (how a value is written) and unit_type (renamed from dd_data_unit; what it means) — plus desired_default_format. Additive: format_label is kept (derived) so the router and verifier are unchanged. A transform planner (fx_format(), fx_plan_transform(), fx_transformable(), fx_apply_plan(), fx_transforms()) models stabilization as a path search over a read_/write_/convert_ registry generated from the ontology recipes; fx_stabilize(..., target_format=) renders to a chosen style (with rendered / target_reachable), and $route now reports format_style.

  • Disambiguator. The ontology carries a disambiguator column declaring the tie-break for every path collision, and fx_validate_ontology() fails on an undeclared one. geographic (a categorical grouping vs. an identifier key) declares cardinality:repeating / cardinality:unique; the colliding unknown/.../mixed leaf is renamed heterogeneous so only the boolean mixed keeps the name. The rule is wired live: guess_data_type() passes the column’s uniqueness ratio to the verifier, which applies it when two confirmed candidates collide — so a repeating FIPS column routes to the categorical geographic grouping and a unique-per-row FIPS column to the identifier key. A new FIPS-validating as_fips recipe also fixes an upstream gap (a county FIPS column used to fall through to count; a random 5-digit number is now correctly rejected as geographic). A collision_group column extends this to cross-type collisions — a column of city names is a geographic grouping when the values repeat and a text/name/place column when they are mostly unique — using the same cardinality rule across leaves that share no semantic_type.

  • Detectors wired (test-case-backed): day_of_week and month_of_year gain selective as_dow / as_moy recipes; first_name, quarter, and domain had their stale implemented flag reconciled; and a new is_currency_amount() (symbol-required, so bare numbers are not mistaken for currency) makes the as_usd recipe selective, wiring usd; place gets a selective lookup:place recipe, min_max range is confirmed via a tightened as_range, and point / polygon are wired via a keyword-gated as_wkt (the geometry family joins the verifier’s always-on set, since the router is too sparse to shortlist it). New is_version() detector. 36 → 46 of 96 variants implemented. Fixes: the transform-DSL arg parser dropped a trailing ] on verb[arg]; as_range no longer claims nested arrays as ranges.

  • Recipe/helper fixes from the datagoodr reintegration review:

    • as_yyyy() and the as_yyyy stabilize verb now strip a fiscal-year prefix ("FY2019" → "2019") instead of returning the raw string / NA.
    • as_EIN() and the as_ein verb now emit the canonical "NN-NNNNNNN" form and restore a leading zero lost to numeric coercion ("12345678" → "01-2345678").
    • Removed the stale duplicate data-types/research_data_type_ontology_v6.csv; fx_ontology() reads inst/extdata/ (the 96-row authority).

  • Two-stage guess_data_type() (router → verifier), anchored to the v6 ontology and returned as a $route record alongside the unchanged legacy fields:

    • Router shortlists candidates. Ships two: a model-free signature router (fx_type_signature() + shortlist_candidates()) and a learned xgboost router over the full fx_extract_features() profile (inst/extdata/router_xgb.rds, trained by data-raw/train_router.R). The router= argument selects "auto" (learned, falling back to signature), "learned", or "signature"; route$router_method reports which ran. Requires the xgboost Suggests; absent it, "auto" degrades to signature.
    • Verifier confirms a leaf with confirm = detect ∘ transform, gated by an empirical foil-selectivity test so permissive recipes (numeric subtypes, free text) truncate to their data_type instead of claiming a false leaf. Tolerant temporal recipes are separated by the column’s own time/date content.
    • Result gracefully truncates to a path prefix (depth 0–4) rather than forcing a leaf.

  • Person/place gazetteers are now public-domain and much larger: .first_names is the top 1000 SSA given names (CC0, via babynames) and .last_names the top 2000 US Census 2010 surnames (public domain), both regenerable from data-raw/gazetteers.R. default_lexicons() gains shipped first-name, last-name, and US-city lists — the learned router’s strongest features (lex_first_name_token ranks #1 by gain).

  • New detector batch (8 detectors, 5 ontology classes across 2 new top-level families):

    • person names — is_first_name(), is_last_name(), is_full_name(), matched against internal SSA given-name and Census surname gazetteers (R/dt-name-data.R); all map to text/line/person_name.
    • is_boolean() — two-state indicator (boolean/binary/indicator), the first detector in the new boolean family.
    • is_wkt_geometry() — WKT spatial literals (structured/spatial/geometry), the first detector in the new structured family.
    • is_quarter(), is_day_of_week(), is_month_of_year() — new temporal classes (period/quarter, phase/day_of_week, phase/month_of_year).

  • Wave 2 (4 detectors):

    • is_fiscal_year() — FY-labelled years and crossover spans (temporal/period/year); bare four-digit years are intentionally excluded as value-indistinguishable from counts/IDs.
    • is_geojson(), is_wkb() — GeoJSON and hex WKB/EWKB, extending the structured/spatial/geometry family alongside is_wkt_geometry().
    • is_json() — JSON object/array literals (text/block/serialized_text); marked loose so is_geojson() claims spatial JSON.

  • Variable-name classifier (prototype) — the name-side complement to the value detectors, for the metadata-gated classes values cannot reveal (weight, rate, estimate, standard error, boolean roles, …):

    • classify_by_name() maps a header to an ontology class via an internal keyword lexicon (.name_lexicon); .tokenize_name() normalizes camelCase/snake/punctuation headers.
    • guess_column() reconciles both modalities VALUES-FIRST: a confident value detector wins; the name classifier fills in only when no value detector fires, so a misleading name can never override a real value signature.
    • Every lexicon coordinate is asserted to be a valid catalog class.

  • External-corpus evaluation harness — evaluate_columns() / eval_summary() score formex against a labeled column corpus via a source-vocabulary crosswalk, reporting per-class precision/recall/F1. Ships a Sherlock/VizNet 78-type -> formex crosswalk (data-raw/eval/sherlock-crosswalk.R) and a runnable ingest+score script (data-raw/eval/run-sherlock-eval.R). Value-only by default (Sherlock labels derive from headers); use_name = TRUE enables the name side for corpora with independent headers (e.g. GitTables).

  • Initial extraction from datagoodr (at tag v0.1.0-monolith).

  • Detector families: address, codes, color, currency, datetime, geography, government IDs, hashes, phone, research/scholarly IDs, science/bio IDs, web.

  • guess_data_type() / score_data_type() — the dispatchable detection entry point, backed by a data-type registry and the type/class/subclass ontology.

  • AutoType test-case generation and detector benchmarking (generate_autotype_test_cases(), build_autotype_results()).

  • as_* format helpers and the formex format-expression syntax.

  • Bundled data: data_type_tests (frozen detector fixture) and internal geography/code lookups; regenerate via data-raw/build_lookups.R and data-raw/build_test_cases.R.
